name: Sandwich
source:
DISCLAIMER: THIS GAME WAS MADE FOR THE ''WORST VISUAL NOVEL EVER' GAME JAM ON ITCH.IO. IT IS MEANT TO BE BAD.



You are hungover, having drank seven pints the night before. You cannot find your box of painkillers, but you have found some bread.

Eh, will do.



You will also curse the everloving crap out of your 'friends' for dragging you up five floor, holding you up by your legs and letting your head and shoulders (TM) hit every single step.

You happen to be British, middle aged, and divorced as well.

[From https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/931032]
translation:
免责声明：本作系为itch.io上的“史上最烂视觉小说”开发大赛而作，就是故意做成烂作的。



昨晚狂灌了七品脱啤酒的你正饱受宿醉折磨。你翻遍屋子也没找着止痛药盒，好在翻出了几片面包。

行吧，凑合也能顶事。



与此同时，你还会把你那帮所谓“损友”的祖宗十八代骂个狗血淋头——昨晚他们拽着你的两条腿硬把你拖上五楼，害得你的头和肩膀（海飞丝™）结结实实撞遍了每一级台阶。

顺带一提，你是个离异的英国中年大叔。

[摘自https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/931032]
